title: nmea0183: Add generic NMEA0183 dissector
description:
- Dissect every message as an unknown sentence. Each sentence field is dissected to a generic item displaying the value
- Most talker id and sentence id will be converted to readable description
- Checksum is verified

Open question:
- ~~Do I need to provide example PCAP?~~
- ~~Is it possible to add tests which verify expert info detection?~~
- ~~Is unknown field and unknown sentence the correct term to use? Is there a standard term for a message variant that the dissector doesn't understand yet?~~

PCAP capture:

[nmea-simulator.pcapng](/uploads/307a92f9b93155610580db5044bd2a81/nmea-simulator.pcapng)
